resolved_findings.resolution: Fresh/preexisting guards run before exclusive build-owner creation. OWNED becomes true only after acquiring that owner. Unowned preflight failures create a separate uniquely named refused-build receipt; owned failures and success both create build-terminal.json exclusively. Existing terminal and owner receipts cannot be overwritten by this invocation.

scope: Narrow static re-read of ownership, exclusive receipt creation, completion and failure paths; original ten-stage, artifact/path/hash and exact test-count review stands.
limitations: No build driver functions, Cargo, compiler, formatter, tests, native runtime or Git were executed. No source or driver edits made.
